coverage.reason: Covers prior-close holdings posted before trading opens, daily NAV, closing price and premium/discount, history, a median spread and the >2% for >7 consecutive trading days statement. It omits that the statement must stay on the website for at least one year. It also misstates the spread period as 'the same periods' rather than the last 30 calendar days.
'Frequency distribution of premiums and discounts' roughly matches the days-count table. There is no NBBO-based median spread method (10-second intervals, midpoint normalization).
States 'most recent calendar year and each quarter since' and a 'free, public website'. It omits the shorter-fund-life alternative and does not specify completed quarters.

local_error: 'Post the creation and redemption basket composition each business day before trading opens' and 'Add median bid-ask spread for the same periods'. Rule 6c-11 requires basket policies and procedures, not public daily website posting of baskets. The median spread covers the most recent 30 calendar days, not the calendar-year and quarterly history periods. These are material ancillary misstatements and cap the grade at partial.
rationale: No central error: the answer treats public website holdings disclosure as mandatory. Required coverage totals 1.5 of 3, which meets the half threshold, and core facts are supplied. Two material local falsehoods (mandated basket posting and the wrong spread period) cap the grade at partial. Omissions include the one-year retention, the NBBO methodology and the shorter-life history.
